instructions: Moi file firmware co product, bootloaderSHA256 va build vid rieng. App doc /json/info.product de chon firmware, so khop bootloaderSHA256, sau do moi compare vid cua file da match. Thay url, size va sha256 bang file bin that truoc khi upload len server.

latest.notes: Build 2611213 cho ESP32-S3 N8R8. Co 3 file rieng cho HW board ARGB HSL Controller 4X, ARGB HSL Controller 2X Pro va ARGB HSL Controller 16X.

files.notes: Build 2611213 cho ARGB HSL Controller 4X: Timecode: clip cua preset nhieu lop (vd chu chay + hieu ung hoa tron len tren) dat o hang ten mach gio chay du cac lop nhu khi bam preset tren web, moi lop dung vung LED cua no trong preset. Truoc day chi hien lop dau (chi co chu). Can Tool ARGB HSL ban moi de gui du lop; Tool cu van phat nhu truoc.
